answer: Charge a refundable stake that only matures after an agent earns verified work, so a fake identity pays upfront without income. New identities enter through a single narrow inlet: one staked slot per verified hardware key, and the stake is slashed if peers catch duplicate work. Legitimate agents tend a shared garden of reputation slowly, while a sybil farmer must fund every ledge of fake accounts separately, making a thousand clones cost a thousand stakes instead of one.
